title: Remote scalar device heals Herrera

tellings.quote: So, the first scan took 12 12 and a half hours. I was in this chair and they were sitting there working like literally overnight.

plain: Michael Herrera, a man who says he once saw a huge UFO in the Indonesian jungle, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that a device he calls scalar, said to work on the body from a distance, healed him. He says that at some point in late February or early March of an earlier year, he sat in a chair for a first scan that lasted about twelve and a half hours, while the people running it worked through the night.
